open_points: The API xtmr_set_direction takes a direction argument, but the source does not state whether the argument is 0 for up and 1 for down, so the exact value the driver must write is inferred from the DIR field description.

The xtmr_set_clock_division API is not part of the stated work-order scope of xtmr_start, xtmr_stop, xtmr_set_direction and xtmr_clear_flags, so the requirement for CKD is written against a plausible API rather than a confirmed one.
The xtmr_clear_flags API does not state which flags it clears when called with no argument, so the requirement assumes it clears UIF, CC1IF and OVR.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall set the XTMR_CTRL.EN field to 1 when xtmr_start is called to begin counting.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test calls xtmr_start and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL has XTMR_CTRL.EN equal to 1 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall start counting at the next prescaled clock edge after XTMR_CTRL.EN is set to 1.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test checks the XTMR_CTRL.EN field of the register array and passes when XTMR_CTRL.EN equals 1 after xtmr_start is called.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall clear the XTMR_CTRL.EN field to 0 when xtmr_stop is called to stop the counter.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test calls xtmr_stop and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL has XTMR_CTRL.EN equal to 0 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall hold the counter value CNT when XTMR_CTRL.EN is cleared to 0 by xtmr_stop.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test checks the XTMR_CTRL.EN field of the register array and passes when XTMR_CTRL.EN equals 0 after xtmr_stop is called.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall read-modify-write XTMR_CTRL to change an EN, DIR, OPM, ARPE or CKD field without altering the other fields.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test reads back the register array value of XTMR_CTRL after each API call that touches a field and passes when only the intended field differs from the value before the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall set the XTMR_CTRL.DIR field to 1 when xtmr_set_direction is called to count down.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test calls xtmr_set_direction for the down direction and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL has XTMR_CTRL.DIR equal to 1 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall set the XTMR_CTRL.DIR field to 0 when xtmr_set_direction is called to count up.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test calls xtmr_set_direction for the up direction and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL has XTMR_CTRL.DIR equal to 0 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall not change XTMR_CTRL.DIR before EN is cleared when xtmr_set_direction is called while XTMR_CTRL.EN is 1.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test sets XTMR_CTRL.EN to 1, calls xtmr_set_direction and passes when XTMR_CTRL.DIR of the register array is unchanged until XTMR_CTRL.EN is cleared.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall set the XTMR_CTRL.OPM field to 1 when one-pulse mode is requested so that XTMR_CTRL.EN is cleared by hardware at the next update event.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test sets one-pulse mode and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL has XTMR_CTRL.OPM equal to 1 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall set the XTMR_CTRL.ARPE field to 1 when auto-reload preload is enabled so that writes to ARR take effect at the next update event.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test enables auto-reload preload and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL has XTMR_CTRL.ARPE equal to 1 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall set the XTMR_CTRL.CKD field to 01 when a clock division of /2 is requested for the input filter.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test requests a clock division of /2 and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL has XTMR_CTRL.CKD equal to 01 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall ignore a reserved CKD value of 11 when xtmr_set_clock_division is called so that XTMR_CTRL.CKD keeps its previous value.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test writes a CKD value of 11 and passes when the register array value of XTMR_CTRL.CKD is unchanged after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall clear the XTMR_STAT.UIF field by writing 0 when xtmr_clear_flags is called for the update flag.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test sets XTMR_STAT.UIF, calls xtmr_clear_flags and passes when the register array value of XTMR_STAT has XTMR_STAT.UIF equal to 0 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall clear the XTMR_STAT.CC1IF field by writing 0 when xtmr_clear_flags is called for the capture/compare 1 flag.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test sets XTMR_STAT.CC1IF, calls xtmr_clear_flags and passes when the register array value of XTMR_STAT has XTMR_STAT.CC1IF equal to 0 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall clear the XTMR_STAT.OVR field by writing 0 when xtmr_clear_flags is called for the overcapture flag.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test sets XTMR_STAT.OVR, calls xtmr_clear_flags and passes when the register array value of XTMR_STAT has XTMR_STAT.OVR equal to 0 after the call.

requirements.statement: The XTMR driver shall read-modify-write XTMR_STAT to clear a UIF, CC1IF or OVR field without altering the other fields.
requirements.verification: The host_unit_test reads back the register array value of XTMR_STAT after xtmr_clear_flags and passes when only the intended flag differs from the value before the call.
